alert_news.title: India to Host First SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum
bullets: India will host the first SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum by the end of 2026.
The plan was announced by Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh at the SCO Council of Heads of Government meeting in Dushanbe, Tajikistan.

alert_news.title: India's First Gold Medal at the Asian Para Games 2026 by Mona Agarwal
bullets: India won its first gold medal at the Asian Para Games 2026 in the women's 10m air rifle standing SH1 event, achieved by shooter Mona Agarwal.
The medal was secured on 19 October 2026, marking India's inaugural gold at the Asian Para Games and setting a new Games record.

alert_news.title: India's First Immunocontraception-Based Leopard Sterilisation Program Launched in Maharashtra
bullets: India's first immunocontraception-based leopard sterilisation program launched by the Junnar forest division, Pune district, Maharashtra, under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC).
Two female leopards were vaccinated and released, marking the first non‑lethal population‑control method for leopards in India.

alert_news.title: Two female leopards sterilised in India's first such initiative
bullets: India's first immunocontraception-based leopard sterilisation program launched by Junnar forest division, Pune, Maharashtra, under MoEFCC.
Two female leopards vaccinated and released, pilot aims to control population through non‑lethal, reversible method, first such initiative in India.

alert_news.title: Aaka Space plans India's first underwater human spaceflight analog mission in Gujarat
bullets: India's first underwater human spaceflight analog mission to be conducted by Aaka Space, Gujarat, simulating spaceflight conditions for astronaut training.
24‑hour trial scheduled for December 2026, followed by 72‑hour mission in March 2027, in partnership with ISRO and Indian Navy.

alert_news.title: India's First Multi-Purpose Vessel INS Samarthak Commissioned
bullets: INS Samarthak, India’s first multi‑purpose vessel (MPV), commissioned at Karwar naval base, built by a private shipyard

75% indigenous content; serves as mothership for unmanned and autonomous surface and aerial vehicles, testbed for weapons and sensors, platform for maritime surveillance, towing, disaster relief and hospital ship

alert_news.title: ISRO completes critical separation tests for Gaganyaan mission
bullets: India’s first human spaceflight mission, Gaganyaan, has completed CM‑SM separation tests at VSSC, Thiruvananthapuram.
The tests validate the crew module’s separation system, including pyrotechnic devices and umbilical jettisoning, ahead of the uncrewed launch targeted for end‑2026.

alert_news.title: Ladakh's Development Momentum
bullets: India’s first geothermal‑heating passenger terminal at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, Leh, built for ₹640 cr.
India’s first Petroglyph Conservation Park at Sindhu Ghat, Ladakh, protecting ancient rock art.
A 298‑km Nimmu‑Padum‑Darcha road by the Border Roads Organisation enhances all‑weather connectivity.

alert_news.title: India's First Geothermal‑Powered Passenger Terminal at Leh Airport
bullets: India's first passenger terminal to use geothermal heating, located at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, Leh, built for Rs 640 crore
India's first Petroglyph Conservation Park established at Sindhu Ghat, safeguarding ancient rock‑art heritage
